# Rerun symptom agreement — Tier-1 /diag on both arms of every rerun pair

*Generated by `scripts/analysis/rerun_diag_symptom_agreement.py` · ruleset `11-intent-text-fallback` · static rules excluded: P15, P16, P43, P6 · questions and reading rules are in the script docstring, fixed before the numbers.*

Agreement = Jaccard of the two runs' rule-hit sets on the same task. Baselines are exact permutation expectations within the pair: **cond** = shuffle among the pair's tasks of the same group; **tmpl** = shuffle among tasks of the same intent template. Excess CIs: cluster bootstrap over (pair, template).

Primary scope = pairs with ≥ 5 flips.
